status: continuous NS1 control law recovered for NS1 Mono (round 2 task 3); predeclared 0.25/0.75 gate PASSES

law.form: piecewise linear in normalized control c with breakpoints 0.2 and 0.8; implemented in plugins/ns1/design.cpp controlParameters()
law.nominalFloor: 1 at c=0 (anchor), else gain(-18.6*17.9/32 dB) for all c>0 (-17.9 = per-band EXPNDR_MAX_ATTEN in every factory preset; -18.6/32 scaling as in helper 0x18002aee0)
law.floorCap: linear in dB from 0 dB (c=0) to -6 dB (c=0.2), then -6 dB (dB-linear chosen by data: at c=0.1 dB-linear chirp nrmse 5.6e-5 vs gain-linear 1.2e-2)
law.front_rounding: front edge allpasses (and the 14000-17000 Hz Q shape) use round(lowerHz)/round(upperHz): the design routine 0x18002e200 calls WCParam_Base::LimitRealWorld on the edge frequency, and ParamXML gives MIN_FC/MAX_FC Resolution 1 Hz; band layout (spacing/extent) uses the unrounded values. Evidence: at c=0.375 rounding everything gives chirp nrmse 8e-4, rounding nothing 5e-4, front-only rounding 4e-5.

grounding.factory_presets: bundle Resources/Presets/1000.xml (read-only, not copied): four presets store NS1 (1Knob, PARAM_WET_DRY_CNTRL) = 25/30/50/80 % together with derived internals MIN_FC 61.667/63.333/70/80, MAX_FC 13833.3/13666.7/13000/12000, LP/HP gain -15/-20/-40/-70 dB, threshold 0.0241667/0.0283333/0.045/0.07. All collinear (slopes 100/3 Hz, -10000/3 Hz, -100 dB, 1/12 per unit) and extrapolate to (60,14000,-10,0.02) at c=0.2; the 80 % preset fixes the 0.8 knot.
grounding.outer_segments: [0,0.2] and [0.8,1] are linear between knots by assumption, supported by one oracle render each (c=0.1, c=0.9); not otherwise grounded.
grounding.caveat_0.25: The 25 % factory preset contributed internal values to the 0.2-0.8 slope, so the 0.25 gate point is not fully independent of the static derivation data (the 0.25 captures themselves were never used). 0.75 coincides with no preset and was never used.
grounding.nelder_mead: 6-parameter Nelder-Mead fits (numpy, driving ns1_render_params) stalled at nrmse 8.8e-3 (c=0.375) and 4e-3/2e-2 (c=0.625) because the front-rounding rule was missing; the law values were recovered from the presets, not from the optimizer.
